text:
Nina (PM): quick thread to lock GA acceptance minimums: SLA wording, public quickstart, runbook, oncall plan, and a conservative pricing floor. owners?
Raj - Eng: I can own SLA + fallback. reality check: cross-region p95 50ms is not achievable for GA; propose Guide vs Guaranteed split.
Raj - Eng: draft suggestion:
```
Guaranteed (Premium): 99.9% availability; p95 guidance 80ms
Guidance (Standard): 99.5% availability; p95 guidance 150ms
Credits: outage credit table + partial credit for sustained latency breach
```
Tess (Docs): I can draft public quickstart + internal runbook. need exact credit math and fallback wording to finish. ETA quickstart 48h, runbook v1 in 6d.
Omar - Support: support plan: P0 -> 24/7 page; P1 -> business hours then oncall; P2 -> ticket. Need triage checklist and templates before GA. Also request 60m L1 training.
Nia (Sales): pricing floor: Sales needs a starting commit metric today. Suggest baseline = 500 rps sustained for the Standard price floor. Also request an "enterprise beta" add-on for custom SLOs at surcharge.
Ava - SRE: monitoring list for GA smoke: error rate, p95 per model family, host GPU OOMs, cache-hit ratio drop. Alerts -> PD mapping required. Also recommend a 72h smoke dashboard.
Nina (PM): owners: @Raj SLA + fallback, @Ava alerts + dashboard, @Tess docs, @Omar support templates + training, @Nia pricing coord with finance. Legal signoff needed on customer SLA language.
Raj - Eng: fallback note: automatic fallback to quantized model per-shard after sustained p95 breach (30s) unless customer opts out. include header x-rw-fallback in response. legal please review wording.
Tess (Docs): will include x-rw-fallback header examples and AE one-liner for demos.
Omar - Support: will draft triage checklist <6 steps and escalation matrix. Need runbook draft link and training slot.
Nia (Sales): finance will need per-10k-token rough cost estimate to finalize floor. @Raj @Ava can you provide?
Ava - SRE: will post infra cost assumptions (gpu hr, average tokens/sec) and a rough per-request cost by EOD tomorrow.
ci-bot: ci-bot: canary deploy to staging (v1.3.2, sha: b7c8d9). smoke tests started. :white_check_mark:
Nina (PM): timeline recap:
- SLA + fallback (Raj) -> draft by tomorrow EOD
- Alerts + dashboard (Ava) -> draft today
- Quickstart + runbook v1 (Tess) -> quickstart 48h, runbook 6d
- Support templates + L1 training (Omar) -> training draft 2d
- Pricing floor + finance check (Nia) -> EOD Wed
Call out blockers now.
Raj - Eng: blocker: need recent p95s from perf infra for small/medium models. @perf-team please share.
Omar - Support: blocker: need access to runbook repo and AE script before training.
Tess (Docs): question: include rollback + feature-flag checklist in runbook? I vote yes.
Nina (PM): yes include rollback steps, kill-switch, and AE notification template. I'll ping legal & finance after Raj uploads SLA wording. :rocket:
